subject: APAC residency & VPC control pack — SIG/CAIQ evidence and keystore logs
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medico.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Patel <sean.patel@medico.io>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: APAC proof pack request — SIG/CAIQ + keystore operator logs

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As part of our procurement security review for our APAC deployment, InfoSec has asked for a compact evidence bundle we can put into our vendor portal:

- Completed SIG Lite/CAIQ index (APAC scope filters highlighted)
- Keystore operator rotation evidence for APAC nodes (redacted where necessary)
- VPC/subnet egress mapping for the APAC tenant(s)
- A short runbook or pointer to the operator roster for keystore access

We need these items by Nov 6 to keep the onboarding timeline. If you can’t share full raw logs, a redacted audit extract that shows operator IDs, rotation timestamps, and KMS key IDs will suffice.

Also please let us know whether the keystore operator is shared across regions or fully isolated for APAC.

Appreciate it — we’re trying to close docs this week.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Security Program Manager
Medico Health

Subject: Re: APAC proof pack request — SIG/CAIQ + keystore operator logs

Hi Lena — thank you and great to meet last week.

We can assemble a scoped package for APAC that addresses SIG/CAIQ questions along with the keystore artifacts you requested. Quick clarifications so we scope correctly:

- Redaction: you asked for redacted operator IDs — do you prefer hashed IDs (sha256) or a stable pseudonym (operator-001)?
- Scope: include both non-prod and prod APAC tenants, or prod-only?
- Timeline: Nov 6 is doable for a compact bundle (index + redacted logs + mapping).

Irene & Grace — can you own the collection? Irene, can teams produce the rotation timeline + redact per Lena’s preference? Grace, can you add the VPC egress mapping CSV and a short operator-runbook snippet?

I’ll collate and drop into a shared drive link and DM Lena when ready.

Thanks,
Mina
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Mina Haddad
Redwood Inference

Mina / Grace,

Quick update on artifacts we can produce this week:

1) Keystore operator rotation extract (redacted) — includes timestamp, operator_pseudonym, key_id, action (rotate), and audit-hash.
   Attachment stub: [attachment: apac-keystore-operator-rotation-redacted.pdf]

2) SIG/CAIQ index (APAC-only) — we've flagged the questions that change based on private deployment and VPC boundaries.
   Attachment stub: [attachment: redacted-sig-caiq-apac-index.xlsx] 

3) VPC topology + egress mapping for APAC tenant — CSV and a short mapping note.
   Attachment stub: [attachment: vpc-subnet-egress-mapping.csv]

Notes:
- The keystore is partitioned by region; APAC has its own operator roster and KMS keys (not shared with US/EU).
- We will provide hashed operator identifiers (sha256) to preserve auditability without exposing PII.
- For non-prod: we will include a separate minimal extract if they explicitly request it; defaulting to prod-only per Mina’s note.

I’ll prepare redactions and upload to the drive folder. Question for Lena: do you need the full CAIQ spreadsheet or a trimmed index with links to supporting artifacts?

Irene
Manager, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks Irene — that sounds perfect. A couple of quick asks before you finalize: 

- Please include the hash algorithm used for operator pseudonyms and a short note about the redaction process (so our audit team can verify integrity).
- For the VPC mapping, can you add a one-line column indicating whether traffic to known cloud-provider control planes is permitted or blocked (we need this for our network risk table).

If Nov 6 is still the target, we’ll expect the Drive link and a small cover note we can upload to our vendor portal. If anything changes, please flag asap.

Best,
Lena
